question: What is the meaning of mass fraction released from the product into the environment during use in relation to product portion released into the environment during its use?
data_group: product portion released into the environment during its use
data_point: mass fraction released from the product into the environment during use
description:
The mass fraction released from the product into the environment during use refers to the portion of the product's mass that is released into the environment during its use. This is a mandatory statement in ISO 59040:2025 and is expressed in accordance with range 1 defined in 6.2. The product portion released into the environment during its use refers to the portion of the product that is released into the environment during its use. This is also a mandatory statement in ISO 59040:2025 and is expressed in accordance with range 1 defined in 6.2. Both statements are related and provide information about the portion of the product that is released into the environment during its use. <||>
